renunciation.effect: Permanently disables controller upgrades and future factory implementation selection

requiredBeforeHumanSigning: Fresh chain1 and canonical block checks
Fresh account-code and direct CREATE envelope checks; nonempty code requires the separate source-bound delegated-four-CREATE review
Exact latest and pending nonce checks with all predicted addresses unused
Fresh balance, fees and explicit gas-cap review
Canonical source-bound preflight and complete exact-bundle deployment rehearsal by the deployment bridge
limitations: Offline gas limits are unapproved proposals; local rehearsal is not a mainnet preflight
The controller owner can upgrade immediately until ownership is renounced
Policy publication, application integration and production hosting are separate actions
